review: 702.75a-1: the expected library order depends on the library listing being top first, which was not stated; added it to setup.notes.

scenarios.title: Hideaway exiles one of the top N cards face down and puts the rest on the bottom
decisions: A casts Collector's Cage, tapping two Plains.
Both players pass; Collector's Cage resolves and enters. The hideaway trigger goes on the stack.
Both players pass; the trigger resolves. A looks at the top five cards and exiles Lightning Bolt face down; the other four go to the bottom in a random order.

variants.label: full_library
variants.expected: Lightning Bolt is in exile face down, linked to Collector's Cage. A's library has six cards: Plains and Swamp on top, then Grizzly Bears, Mountain, Island and Forest in some order.

variants.label: short_library
variants.delta: A's library is only Lightning Bolt and Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: A looks at both cards and exiles Lightning Bolt face down. Grizzly Bears goes to the bottom of the library and is the only card in it.

variants.label: empty_library
variants.expected: The hideaway trigger resolves with no cards to look at. Nothing is exiled and Collector's Cage stays on the battlefield.
